english_evidence: Aggregator lists single instruction language: 'Taal: Nederlands'. No mention of English instruction on any aggregator or CBR page.
notes: Single-instructor school (1 persoon werkzaam), vennootschap onder firma. Certified faalangst/rijangst/autisme (test-anxiety/driving-anxiety/autism) instructor; uses Rijopleiding In Stappen (RIS) method. Category B (personenauto) only at CBR Den Bosch; theory also offered for auto + bromfiets per CBR. Transmission classified 'manual' because no 'Automaat' tag appears for this school across aggregators (rijloket/clickdrive tag peers like van Grunderbeek and De Parel as Automaat, but not this one) and only standard schakel personenauto lessons are listed; absence-of-automaat inference, hence not 'both'. Founding year 2006 corroborated by rijloket ('Sinds 2006 / Actief sinds 2006 (20 jaar)') and rijschool-tips ('20 jaar geleden opgericht'). KvK 76861937 (CBR/rijschoolspecialist; rijschool-vinder cites legacy KvK Oost-Brabant 17184896). Google reviews praise warm, calm, patient style. NOTE: clickdrive.nl page contained mismatched boilerplate (Hanodrive text, 178 reviews, Utrecht 030 number) and was disregarded for rating/review counts.
